description: Implementation of QuicSimpleServerStream class handling HTTP/QUIC stream processing, including headers, body, responses, and error handling within a QUIC server.

classes.name: DelayedResponseAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate class to handle delayed backend responses for QuicSimpleServerStream.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when the alarm triggers, responding with the stored response.

methods.name: OnResponseBackendComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of backend response, scheduling delayed response if needed.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends the backend response, including early hints, error handling, or response data.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Initiates sending a response based on request headers and backend data.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with specified response code.

methods.name: SendIncompleteResponse
methods.description: Sends response headers and body without finalizing the stream.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Sends headers and body as a complete response.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBodyAndTrailers
methods.description: Sends headers, body, and trailers, finalizing the response.

methods.name: WriteGeneratedBytes
methods.description: Writes generated byte data in chunks for responses of type GENERATE_BYTES.

methods.name: TerminateStreamWithError
methods.description: Terminates the stream with a specified error.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Callback when the stream is ready to write more data.

methods.name: IsConnectRequest
methods.description: Checks if the current request is a CONNECT method.
